name: Maria Giannetta

residences.place: Sand Street, Dunmore, PA (next door to James and Mollie Petriello at no. 128)
residences.note: Wife, 47, born Italy, naturalized; husband Joseph Pichiarello, 57, born Italy, proprietor of a retail grocery store; son James 21, sales clerk in the grocery; daughter Angelica (23) and her husband Anthony Marciano.

bioAdditions: Maria came from Bisaccia with her mother about 1909 (she is 'Marie', 8, in the 1910 census) and married Joseph Pichiarello, an Italian-born grocer (S2, S1). In April 1950 the Pichiarellos lived on Sand Street in Dunmore, next door to her sister Mollie Petriello's family. Joseph was proprietor of a retail grocery store, their son James worked in it as a sales clerk, and their married daughter Angelica and her husband Anthony Marciano lived with them (S1).
